question: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales.
sql:
-- Show all for verification
WITH pre_post AS (
  SELECT 'region' as attr_type, region as attr_value, week_number, SUM(sales) as weekly_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY region, week_number
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform' as attr_type, platform as attr_value, week_number, SUM(sales) as weekly_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY platform, week_number
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band' as attr_type, age_band as attr_value, week_number, SUM(sales) as weekly_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY age_band, week_number
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic' as attr_type, demographic as attr_value, week_number, SUM(sales) as weekly_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY demographic, week_number
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type' as attr_type, customer_type as attr_value, week_number, SUM(sales) as weekly_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales WHERE calendar_year = 2020
  GROUP BY customer_type, week_number
),
pct_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    attr_type,
    attr_value,
    (AVG(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 THEN weekly_sales END) - AVG(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN weekly_sales END)) 
    / AVG(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN weekly_sales END) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM pre_post
  GROUP BY attr_type, attr_value
)
SELECT 
  attr_type,
  ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change
FROM pct_changes
GROUP BY attr_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
